title: II–VIII. Prophetic office: imposition, sanctification, instruction, promise of help
pass_a_gloss: Pass A clause gloss (reordered): Christs prophecy stands as necessary to eternal salvation, because without ye knowledge belonging toward God and belonging toward Christ salvation does not come about. — The PROMISE belonging toward help stands as that same which by which ye Father promises His aid to ye Son toward discharging this munus. — VIII. — INSTRUCTION stands as that same which by which ye gifts necessary toward prophecy were conferred on Him. — VI. — SANCTIFICATION stands as that same which by which Christ was separately destined and consecrated by ye Father to ye prophetic munus. — V. — In ye imposition stand as contemplated sanctification, instruction, and ye promise belonging toward help. — IV. — This prophecy belonging toward Christ stands as not only that same which He confirmed ye old law and ye evangelical promise made to ye fathers belonging toward ye Old Testament, but that same which He more fully disclosed ye new gospel. — III. — The PROPHECY belonging toward Christ stands as considered both in its imposition and in its execution. — II. — Latin anchors: PROPHETIA, Christi, consideratur, impositione, executione, autem, prophetia, Christi, tantum, veterem, legem, promissionem, Euangelicam, patribus, factam, confirmaverit, Euangelium, novum, plenius, patefecerit
pass_b_english: II. The PROPHECY of Christ is considered both in its imposition and in its execution. III. This prophecy of Christ is not only that He confirmed the old law and the evangelical promise made to the fathers of the Old Testament, but that He more fully disclosed the new gospel.

IV. In the imposition are contemplated sanctification, instruction, and the promise of help. V. SANCTIFICATION is that by which Christ was separately destined and consecrated by the Father to the prophetic munus. VI. INSTRUCTION is that by which the gifts necessary for prophecy were conferred on Him. VIII. The PROMISE of help is that by which the Father promises His aid to the Son for discharging this munus.
Christs prophecy is necessary to eternal salvation, because without the knowledge of God and of Christ salvation does not come about.
source_text: II. PROPHETIA Christi consideratur tum in eius impositione, tum in executione. III. Est autem haec prophetia Christi non tantum ut veterem legem & promissionem Euangelicam patribus V.T. factam confirmaverit, sed Euangelium novum plenius patefecerit. IV. In impositione spectatur sanctificatio, instructio & auxilii promissio. V. SANCTIFICATIO est, qua Christus a Patre ad munus propheticum seorsim destinatus & consecratus est. VI. INSTRUCTIO est, qua dona ad prophetiam necessaria ipsi collata sunt. VIII. Auxilii PROMISSIO est, qua Pater Filio ad hoc munus obeundum opem suam pollicetur. Prophetia Christi ad aeternam salutem est necessaria, quia sine cognitione Dei & Christi salus non contingit.
